slime_gel.name: Slime Gel
slime_gel.desc: Cool, wobbly goo. Smiths and alchemists will want it.

boar_tusk.name: Boar Tusk
boar_tusk.desc: Yellowed and heavy. A smith could do something with it.

brine_key.name: Brine Key
brine_key.desc: A salt-crusted key. Opens the boathouse door.

lucky_rake.name: Osk's Lucky Rake
lucky_rake.desc: A worn salt rake with a ribbon tied to the handle.

salt_locket.name: Salt Locket
salt_locket.desc: Maren's mother's locket. A sun is etched on the lid.

gnarled_staff.name: Gnarled Staff
gnarled_staff.desc: A bent branch that hums when held.

dented_mace.name: Dented Mace
dented_mace.desc: Has seen better days and worse skulls.

gel_tusk_axe.name: Gelboar Tusk Axe
gel_tusk_axe.desc: A tusk grown through with glassy slime.

gelatin_mace.name: Gelatin Mace
gelatin_mace.desc: Wobbles on the swing and hits like a wall.

slimeglass_robe.name: Slimeglass Robe
slimeglass_robe.desc: Woven from hardened slime. Sings faintly.

worn_mail.name: Worn Mail
worn_mail.desc: A few rings short of a shirt.

goblin_ear.name: Goblin Ear
goblin_ear.desc: Notched and grubby. A bounty clerk might want it.

goblin_crown.name: Goblin Crown
goblin_crown.desc: A circlet of bent spoons and bone. Dreadful taste, decent silver.

smith_hammer.name: Arlo's Hammer
smith_hammer.desc: A well-worn smith's hammer, the handle black with years of grip.

tide_chart.name: Tide-Chart
tide_chart.desc: A waxed chart marked with dig sites. One is circled in red: Reedhollow.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.desc: Heavier, straighter and a good deal meaner.

ash_staff.name: Ash Staff
ash_staff.desc: Pale wood, tight grain, faint hum.

longbow.name: Longbow
longbow.desc: Taller than you, and it shows.

iron_dagger.name: Iron Dagger
iron_dagger.desc: Narrow, quick, and unfussy about where it goes.

fangblade.name: Fangblade
fangblade.desc: A curved blade grown from a hybrid's fang.

silkweave_staff.name: Silkweave Staff
silkweave_staff.desc: Wrapped in spider silk that hums with static.

viper_bow.name: Viper Bow
viper_bow.desc: Strung with silk. Never goes slack.

cobweb_mace.name: Cobweb Mace
cobweb_mace.desc: Strands of silk bind the head tight. Surprisingly heavy.

studded_leather.name: Studded Leather
studded_leather.desc: Leather with iron studs set by hand.

spidersilk_vest.name: Spidersilk Vest
spidersilk_vest.desc: Woven by something that never stopped weaving.

glowreed.name: Glowreed
glowreed.desc: A reed that gives off a faint, steady light. Lamp-keepers prize it.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.desc: Thick grey fur. A tanner would pay for this.

greyfang_tooth.name: Greyfang's Tooth
greyfang_tooth.desc: A yellowed fang as long as your hand.

toll_ledger.name: Toll Ledger
toll_ledger.desc: A bandit's account book. Every toll collected here is shipped north to Gallowkeep.

temple_lamp.name: Temple Lamp
temple_lamp.desc: A small oil lamp, older than anything in Reedhollow. Its flame leans toward your palm. Carried in the pack, it lets you see three tiles further on night maps.

gaff_sword.name: Gaff Sword
gaff_sword.desc: A boat-hook blade with a marsh-man's curve.

eel_dagger.name: Eelskin Dagger
eel_dagger.desc: Grip wrapped in eelskin. Never slips.

shriekwood_staff.name: Shriekwood Staff
shriekwood_staff.desc: It whistles when you swing it.

nightwing_bow.name: Nightwing Bow
nightwing_bow.desc: A bow strung with bat-wing sinew. It shoots quieter than the dark.

howling_mace.name: Howling Mace
howling_mace.desc: The head howls on the downswing.

reedweave_vest.name: Reedweave Vest
reedweave_vest.desc: Tight-woven reed over leather. Light and waterproof.

spider_silk.name: Spider Silk
spider_silk.desc: Strong, fine thread. Weavers and smiths will pay for it.

spider_venom.name: Spider Venom
spider_venom.desc: A sealed vial of cloudy venom. Alchemists want it.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: A rust-red lump. A smith could do something with it.

sunstone_chip.name: Sunstone Chip
sunstone_chip.desc: A chip of pale stone that glows faintly in rhythm with your palm. Merchants pay well for it.

cragblade.name: Cragblade
cragblade.desc: Hammered from mine-iron. Cold even in the sun.

pickaxe.name: Miner's Pickaxe
pickaxe.desc: Built for rock, which is harder than most enemies.

lantern_staff.name: Lantern Staff
lantern_staff.desc: A lamp-head on an ash shaft. It never goes out.

delver_bow.name: Delver's Bow
delver_bow.desc: Short and stiff. Made for tunnels.

tunnel_mace.name: Tunnel Mace
tunnel_mace.desc: A stone head and a ringing handle.

venomfang_sword.name: Venomfang Sword
venomfang_sword.desc: A crooked blade grown from a spider's fang.

oozeglass_staff.name: Oozeglass Staff
oozeglass_staff.desc: Clear as water. It drips, faintly.

silkstrike_bow.name: Silkstrike Bow
silkstrike_bow.desc: Silk-strung. Fires as if it knew where you wanted to hit.

gluemaul.name: Gluemaul
gluemaul.desc: The head clings to whatever it strikes.

miners_leathers.name: Miner's Leathers
miners_leathers.desc: Thick, scarred and stained with ore dust.

rivet_plate.name: Rivet Plate
rivet_plate.desc: Riveted by someone who hated gaps.

weavers_wrap.name: Weaver's Wrap
weavers_wrap.desc: Spun and woven by something with too many hands.

phoenix_plume.name: Phoenix Plume
phoenix_plume.desc: Revives a fallen ally with 40% HP.

orc_tooth.name: Orc Tooth
orc_tooth.desc: A thick yellow tusk. Orcs wear these as trophies.

dawn_shard.name: Dawn Shard
dawn_shard.desc: A lump of pale gold, warm as a hand. The first of the four Sunshards.

gallows_token.name: Gallows Token
gallows_token.desc: A black iron token stamped with a gallows. Hask's men carry them as proof of rank.

ridge_sabre.name: Ridge Sabre
ridge_sabre.desc: Forged in the camp from stolen Gallowkeep iron.

ridge_staff.name: Ridge Staff
ridge_staff.desc: Pine from the ridge, bound in wire.

ridge_bow.name: Ridge Bow
ridge_bow.desc: A heavy bow for long shots across the pass.

ridge_mace.name: Ridge Mace
ridge_mace.desc: A heavy head on a short haft.

tuskrender_greatsword.name: Tuskrender Blade
tuskrender_greatsword.desc: A blade grown out of a tusk the size of a plough.

warhorn_staff.name: Warhorn Staff
warhorn_staff.desc: Carved from a horn. It hums on the wind.

ironhide_bow.name: Ironhide Bow
ironhide_bow.desc: Bound in boar-hide that refuses to stretch.

ridge_jacket.name: Ridge Jacket
ridge_jacket.desc: Quiet cloth over a hide lining.

ridge_robe.name: Ridge Robe
ridge_robe.desc: Heavy wool, warm as a stove.

tuskhide_mail.name: Tuskhide Mail
tuskhide_mail.desc: Plate backed with the hide of something enormous.

silver_ore.name: Silver Ore
silver_ore.desc: Pale, heavy and soft. Smiths prize it for fine work.

garnet.name: Garnet
garnet.desc: A dark red gem, rough from the rock.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.desc: Blue as deep water. Jewellers pay well.

ember_opal.name: Ember Opal
ember_opal.desc: It glows faintly, like a coal that will not go out.

smith_blade.name: Smith-forged Blade
smith_blade.desc: A plain, honest sword, forged by your own hand.

smith_mace.name: Smith-forged Mace
smith_mace.desc: A flanged head on a forged haft.

master_blade.name: Masterwork Blade
master_blade.desc: Folded, quenched, and folded again. A smith signs this one.

master_staff.name: Masterwork Staff
master_staff.desc: Folded, quenched, and folded again. A smith signs this one.

master_bow.name: Masterwork Bow
master_bow.desc: Folded, quenched, and folded again. A smith signs this one.

master_mace.name: Masterwork Mace
master_mace.desc: Folded, quenched, and folded again. A smith signs this one.

smith_plate.name: Smith-forged Plate
smith_plate.desc: Cut, fitted and riveted by someone who cares.

smith_robe.name: Smith-forged Robe
smith_robe.desc: Cut, fitted and riveted by someone who cares.

smith_jacket.name: Smith-forged Jacket
smith_jacket.desc: Cut, fitted and riveted by someone who cares.

smith_leathers.name: Smith-forged Leathers
smith_leathers.desc: Cut, fitted and riveted by someone who cares.

hawkeye_bow.name: Hawkeye Bow
hawkeye_bow.desc: Strung with something that was once an eagle feather.

viper_dagger.name: Viper Dagger
viper_dagger.desc: It finds the gap every time.

lifetap_mace.name: Lifetap Mace
lifetap_mace.desc: Warm to the touch after a hit.

sages_rod.name: Sage's Rod
sages_rod.desc: Whoever carries it remembers more of what they see.

emberbrand.name: Emberbrand
emberbrand.desc: The edge glows a dull orange and never quite cools.

stormhatchet.name: Stormhatchet
stormhatchet.desc: Hair stands up when it is swung.

bloodmoon_mace.name: Bloodmoon Mace
bloodmoon_mace.desc: Red, and always a little damp.

dawnguard_bow.name: Dawnguard Bow
dawnguard_bow.desc: Sighted by someone who never missed a sunrise.

tempest_staff.name: Tempest Staff
tempest_staff.desc: The crystal at the tip hums before rain.

boarward_vest.name: Boarward Vest
boarward_vest.desc: Stitched with a charm against bad meat.

foxhide_jacket.name: Foxhide Jacket
foxhide_jacket.desc: Light on the shoulders, impossible to pin down.

wardens_plate.name: Warden's Plate
wardens_plate.desc: Gate-warden issue. It does not move unless you do.

nightsilk_robe.name: Nightsilk Robe
nightsilk_robe.desc: Dark and cool, and strangely restful.

scholars_cloak.name: Scholar's Cloak
scholars_cloak.desc: Smells of ink and old libraries.

grand_elixir.name: Grand Elixir
grand_elixir.desc: Restores 500 HP and 120 MP and clears most ailments.

hewers_axe.name: Hewer's Axe
hewers_axe.desc: Balanced for one more swing than the last man had.

bulwark_mail.name: Bulwark Mail
bulwark_mail.desc: Every ring is stamped with a tiny sun.

starweave_robe.name: Starweave Robe
starweave_robe.desc: The weave is a pattern you almost recognise.

moonbead_staff.name: Moonbead Staff
moonbead_staff.desc: A pale bead rolls at the tip when you are not looking.

sunmark_mace.name: Sunmark Mace
sunmark_mace.desc: Stamped with a sun that has seen better days.

steel_sword.name: Steel Sword
steel_sword.desc: Khesh-Ura steel, folded in desert heat.

steel_axe.name: Steel Axe
steel_axe.desc: A broad bearded blade on an ash haft.

steel_staff.name: Steel-capped Staff
steel_staff.desc: A glass bead set in a steel cap.

steel_bow.name: Steel Bow
steel_bow.desc: Spring steel limbs; it fires like a slammed door.

steel_dagger.name: Steel Dagger
steel_dagger.desc: Slim, bright, and always a little too sharp.

steel_mace.name: Steel Mace
steel_mace.desc: A ribbed steel head that rings like a bell.

steel_plate.name: Steel Plate
steel_plate.desc: Overlapping plates; a lizardfolk smith made them slightly too roomy.

dune_leathers.name: Dune Leathers
dune_leathers.desc: Hide cured in salt and dyed the colour of dusk.

sandsilk_jacket.name: Sandsilk Jacket
sandsilk_jacket.desc: Weightless, cool and surprisingly hard to cut.

sunweave_robe.name: Sunweave Robe
sunweave_robe.desc: Threads the colour of a low sun.

grumble_cleaver.name: Grumble Cleaver
grumble_cleaver.desc: A cleaver the size of a door, still warm from the ogre that wielded it.

ogrebone_staff.name: Ogrebone Staff
ogrebone_staff.desc: A femur, wound with silver wire. It hums when it is hungry.

tusker_longbow.name: Tusker Longbow
tusker_longbow.desc: Strung with boar-gut and set with a curved tusk.

khesh_maul.name: Maul of Khesh
khesh_maul.desc: A paving stone on a drover's pole. Very simple. Very effective.

grumblehide_vest.name: Grumblehide Vest
grumblehide_vest.desc: Ogre hide, hardened. It smells like a barn that lost a war.

ogre_tooth.name: Ogre Tooth
ogre_tooth.desc: Yellow, chipped, and heavier than it looks.

sandtusk_tusk.name: Sandtusk Tusk
sandtusk_tusk.desc: A curved tusk the length of your arm, rust-red at the root.

silvered_sword.name: Silvered Sword
silvered_sword.desc: Silver-bright and a little light in the hand, which makes it quicker.

silvered_axe.name: Silvered Axe
silvered_axe.desc: A silver edge on a black haft.

silvered_staff.name: Silvered Staff
silvered_staff.desc: Silver wire runs the length of it and hums in the heat.

silvered_bow.name: Silvered Bow
silvered_bow.desc: Silvered limbs that flash a warning before you loose.

silvered_dagger.name: Silvered Dagger
silvered_dagger.desc: A bright blade that throws a thin line of light.

silvered_mace.name: Silvered Mace
silvered_mace.desc: A silvered head that rings softly on a good strike.

silvered_plate.name: Silvered Plate
silvered_plate.desc: Plate dipped in silver and light as it looks.

sunhide_coat.name: Sunhide Coat
sunhide_coat.desc: Hide that has learned to shrug off the heat.

mirage_jacket.name: Mirage Jacket
mirage_jacket.desc: It shimmers when you move, and so does the eye that follows you.

moonlace_robe.name: Moonlace Robe
moonlace_robe.desc: Pale lace over cool wool. It never feels warm.

stinger_blade.name: Stinger Blade
stinger_blade.desc: A sword with a barbed tip, quick as a flick of a tail.

webglass_staff.name: Webglass Staff
webglass_staff.desc: A glass rod spun through with spider-silk.

spidertail_bow.name: Spidertail Bow
spidertail_bow.desc: Strung with a thread that tugs at your fingers.

carapace_mace.name: Carapace Mace
carapace_mace.desc: A mace-head of black chitin, polished by a hundred fights.

scale_plate.name: Lizard Scale
scale_plate.desc: A broad, glossy scale, warm even in the shade.

scorpion_stinger.name: Scorpion Stinger
scorpion_stinger.desc: A curved barb that still weeps a little venom.

chitin_shard.name: Chitin Shard
chitin_shard.desc: A black fragment, hard as slate.

khesh_writ.name: Szazz's Writ
khesh_writ.desc: A writ of passage signed by Khesh-Ura's Water-Warden. It opens the road east.

ismerel_writ.name: Ismerel's Writ
ismerel_writ.desc: A glass-sealed order from the Queen, naming a toll of one tenth of the sun.

desert_spice.name: Desert Spice
desert_spice.desc: A red powder that makes your eyes water politely.

harpy_egg.name: Harpy Egg
harpy_egg.desc: A speckled egg, warm even when it has been out of the nest for hours.

bone_dust.name: Bone Dust
bone_dust.desc: Grey and fine. It smells of old chalk.

clear_tea.name: Clear Tea
clear_tea.desc: Cures sleep, charm and curse. Bitter, as it should be.

cliffwing_bow.name: Cliffwing Bow
cliffwing_bow.desc: Strung with harpy sinew and fletched with their feathers.

screech_staff.name: Screechwing Staff
screech_staff.desc: A bone rod that whines faintly in the wind.

talon_blade.name: Talon Blade
talon_blade.desc: A curved blade that looks, in some light, like a claw.

echo_mace.name: Echo Mace
echo_mace.desc: It rings twice for every blow.

featherweave_vest.name: Featherweave Vest
featherweave_vest.desc: Woven feather-vanes over hide. Light and surprisingly tough.

perch_token.name: Waystation Token
perch_token.desc: A brass token stamped with a well. Marrak Sen says it opens the east road.

glass_plate.name: Glass Plate
glass_plate.desc: Plate of tempered glass; it rings like a bell and stops most things.

glasshide_coat.name: Glasshide Coat
glasshide_coat.desc: Hide laid with glass scales, flexible as a fish.

glassveil_jacket.name: Glassveil Jacket
glassveil_jacket.desc: A jacket of glass threads that scatters light and blows.

glassthread_robe.name: Glassthread Robe
glassthread_robe.desc: Spun glass, soft as silk, cold as water.

ossuary_blade.name: Ossuary Blade
ossuary_blade.desc: A blade of fused bone, cold to hold.

crypt_staff.name: Crypt Staff
crypt_staff.desc: A rod of grave-glass with a skull-sized crystal.

grave_bow.name: Grave Bow
grave_bow.desc: It creaks like a coffin lid before every shot.

tombstone_mace.name: Tombstone Mace
tombstone_mace.desc: A small headstone on a long handle. It has someone's name on it.

ossuary_plate.name: Ossuary Plate
ossuary_plate.desc: Plate of bone and glass, knitted by something patient.

golem_core.name: Golem Core
golem_core.desc: A heavy, humming stone. It is faintly warm.

glass_token.name: Perch Token
glass_token.desc: A glass disc stamped with a cliff. Tamsin Oake says it opens the south road.

crate_khesh.name: Crate for Khesh-Ura
crate_khesh.desc: A sealed crate addressed to Qeth Arun, Bazaar-Keeper.

crate_waystation.name: Crate for Redwater
crate_waystation.desc: A sealed crate addressed to Vessa Korr, Quartermaster.

crate_perch.name: Crate for Perch
crate_perch.desc: A sealed crate addressed to Ferdie Plum, Provisioner.

runed_sword.name: Runed Sword
runed_sword.desc: Runes march down the fuller and hum when you swing.

runed_axe.name: Runed Axe
runed_axe.desc: An axe of black iron with a running line of silver runes.

runed_staff.name: Runed Staff
runed_staff.desc: Runes spiral up the shaft and brighten as you cast.

runed_bow.name: Runed Bow
runed_bow.desc: Runes on the grip steady your aim.

runed_dagger.name: Runed Dagger
runed_dagger.desc: A narrow blade, with a rune for every kill it remembers.

runed_mace.name: Runed Mace
runed_mace.desc: Runes of mending are cut into the flanges.

runed_plate.name: Runed Plate
runed_plate.desc: Plate with a rune on every join. Heavy, and very difficult to hurt.

runed_hide.name: Runed Hide
runed_hide.desc: Hide worked with runes of turning.

runed_cloak.name: Runed Cloak
runed_cloak.desc: A cloak that shrugs off a blow as water sheds rain.

runed_robe.name: Runed Robe
runed_robe.desc: Runes of focus run down both sleeves.

ironhorn_greatsword.name: Ironhorn Greatsword
ironhorn_greatsword.desc: A horn-hilted blade that wants to charge.

horned_staff.name: Horned Staff
horned_staff.desc: A staff tipped with a polished minotaur horn.

bullhorn_bow.name: Bullhorn Bow
bullhorn_bow.desc: Limbs of horn; it throws like a charging bull.

rampage_mace.name: Rampage Mace
rampage_mace.desc: It hits twice as hard when you are angry.

ironhorn_plate.name: Ironhorn Plate
ironhorn_plate.desc: Plate hammered from a minotaur's own armour.

minotaur_horn.name: Minotaur Horn
minotaur_horn.desc: A thick curved horn, scored with the maze's turns.

mirror_key.name: Mirror Key
mirror_key.desc: A key of mirrored glass. Rhea Corvane says it opens the road east.

zenith_shard.name: Zenith Shard
zenith_shard.desc: A shard of the noon sun, bright and heavy, and warm as a held hand.

moonsteel_sword.name: Moonsteel Sword
moonsteel_sword.desc: A pale blade that keeps the memory of moonlight.

moonsteel_axe.name: Moonsteel Axe
moonsteel_axe.desc: A pale axe that never quite dulls.

moonsteel_staff.name: Moonsteel Staff
moonsteel_staff.desc: A staff of pale metal, cold and fine as a harp wire.

moonsteel_bow.name: Moonsteel Bow
moonsteel_bow.desc: An elven bow of pale metal. It sings when drawn.

moonsteel_dagger.name: Moonsteel Dagger
moonsteel_dagger.desc: A hand-length of moonlight with an edge.

moonsteel_mace.name: Moonsteel Mace
moonsteel_mace.desc: A pale mace that rings gently on impact.

moonsteel_plate.name: Moonsteel Plate
moonsteel_plate.desc: Elven plate: light, silver and astonishingly hard.

moonsteel_hide.name: Moonsteel Hide
moonsteel_hide.desc: Hide stitched with fine moonsteel thread.

moonsteel_cloak.name: Moonsteel Cloak
moonsteel_cloak.desc: A cloak woven with silver wire. It turns water, arrows and eyes.

moonsteel_robe.name: Moonsteel Robe
moonsteel_robe.desc: A robe of moonsteel thread that hums softly in the dark.

wraith_blade.name: Wraith Blade
wraith_blade.desc: A blade that is only partly there. It cuts the rest.

ghostwood_staff.name: Ghostwood Staff
ghostwood_staff.desc: A staff of pale wood that whispers in your ear.

silent_bow.name: Silent Bow
silent_bow.desc: It makes no sound, whether drawn or fired.

lament_mace.name: Lament Mace
lament_mace.desc: It sounds, very faintly, like a mourner.

wraithbound_mail.name: Wraithbound Mail
wraithbound_mail.desc: Elven mail that has been somewhere cold.

elf_silk.name: Elven Silk
elf_silk.desc: Fine as breath and strong as wire.

moon_petal.name: Moon Petal
moon_petal.desc: A silver petal that glows faintly at night.

frost_token.name: Lamplighter Lantern
frost_token.desc: A little brass lantern with a Lamplighter badge. Captain Rook says it will see you through the north road.

lost_tome_a.name: Lost Tome: Verses of the Hush
lost_tome_a.desc: A water-stained book of elven verses, with one page torn out.

lost_tome_b.name: Lost Tome: The Archer's Rule
lost_tome_b.desc: A small leather book of archery rules, written by a master.

lost_tome_c.name: Lost Tome: Names of the Moon
lost_tome_c.desc: A thick, silvered book, half-eaten by damp.

barkhide_blade.name: Barkhide Blade
barkhide_blade.desc: A blade grown, not forged, from a branch that refused to burn.

rootbound_staff.name: Rootbound Staff
rootbound_staff.desc: A living root coils round a crystal. It seems to breathe.

thornwood_bow.name: Thornwood Bow
thornwood_bow.desc: Thorns line the grip. It bites, and it lets you know.

heartwood_mace.name: Heartwood Mace
heartwood_mace.desc: The head is one dense knot of heartwood. It hits like a falling tree.

barkhide_plate.name: Barkhide Plate
barkhide_plate.desc: Bark armour that flexes with every breath. It has a faint smell of resin.

heartwood_sap.name: Heartwood Sap
heartwood_sap.desc: Thick amber sap, warm to the touch even in the frost.

frost_bark.name: Frost Bark
frost_bark.desc: Silver bark that stays cold in a fire.

root_token.name: Speaker's Seal
root_token.desc: A small seal of silver bark. Speaker Ilvaren says it will open the east road to Rootmere.

explorer_map.name: The Explorer's Map
explorer_map.desc: A waxed map, smudged with ice and old blood. The margin reads: 'Three caches. One in the wood, one under the frost, one where the moss sleeps.'

bryce_key.name: Bryce's Journal
bryce_key.desc: A leather journal. The last entry is a single line: the mark is the key.

silver_oil.name: Silver Oil
silver_oil.desc: Coats one ally's weapon in silver for six turns, so it bites ghosts and wolves of the night.

moonfang_blade.name: Moonfang Blade
moonfang_blade.desc: A long fang of silvered bone, set in a hilt of pale wood.

lunar_staff.name: Lunar Staff
lunar_staff.desc: A staff topped with a disc of white stone that tracks the moon.

howling_bow.name: Howling Bow
howling_bow.desc: The string sings a low, hollow note when drawn.

fangbreaker_mace.name: Fangbreaker Mace
fangbreaker_mace.desc: A mace of grey iron, studded with a wolf's teeth.

moonfang_plate.name: Moonfang Plate
moonfang_plate.desc: Plate lined with silver wire and pelt. It smells faintly of rain.

moon_pelt.name: Moon Pelt
moon_pelt.desc: Thick grey fur with a faint silver shimmer.

wraith_essence.name: Wraith Essence
wraith_essence.desc: A cold, unsteady glow in a stoppered vial.

moor_lantern.name: Moor Lantern
moor_lantern.desc: A little brass lantern with a green glass. Maelis Thorne says it will keep you on the path across Hollowmoor.

stone_salve.name: Stone Salve
stone_salve.desc: A grey paste that loosens stone-struck flesh.

rune_dust.name: Rune Dust
rune_dust.desc: Powdered rune-stone. Enchanters set it into gear.

rune_stone.name: Rune Stone
rune_stone.desc: A palm-sized stone that hums when you hold it. Tamsin Orrel wants it.

vael_gate_key.name: Vael Gate Key
vael_gate_key.desc: A black iron key that opens the postern of Keep Vael.

vael_pass.name: Vael Pass
vael_pass.desc: A wax-sealed token from Lantern Hold. It lets you through the west road toward Keep Vael.

dark_shard.name: Dark Shard
dark_shard.desc: A chip of black armour that stays cold.

basilisk_scale.name: Basilisk Scale
basilisk_scale.desc: A dull grey scale, hard as slate.

commander_crest.name: Commander's Crest
commander_crest.desc: The crest of the Dark Knight Commander. It hums with a vow.

wightbane_blade.name: Wightbane Blade
wightbane_blade.desc: A pale blade that rings against the dead.

gravecall_staff.name: Gravecall Staff
gravecall_staff.desc: A staff of grave-wood. It listens for answers.

ghostwind_bow.name: Ghostwind Bow
ghostwind_bow.desc: Arrows loosed from it do not seem to travel; they arrive.

grave_mace.name: Grave Mace
grave_mace.desc: A mace of black iron, wrapped in a shroud of silver thread.

wight_shroud.name: Wight Shroud
wight_shroud.desc: A mail shirt that is cold to touch and oddly comforting.

bier_seal.name: Bier Seal
bier_seal.desc: A grey wax seal stamped with a closed eye. Isolde Marrow says the Bier Road will let a bearer of this pass.

dusk_shard.name: Dusk-shard
dusk_shard.desc: A splinter of the dusk, cold and heavy as a coin of lead. It was given freely, which is the strangest thing about it.

wyvern_scale.name: Wyvern Scale
wyvern_scale.desc: A scale the size of a hand, warm as a stove.

galeforged_blade.name: Galeforged Blade
galeforged_blade.desc: A blade whose edge hums in a headwind.

windcaller_staff.name: Windcaller Staff
windcaller_staff.desc: A staff of pale ash that bends the air around its tip.

skyreach_bow.name: Skyreach Bow
skyreach_bow.desc: Strung with a wyvern tendon; its arrows fall upward before they fall down.

gale_mace.name: Gale Mace
gale_mace.desc: A mace with a head of fused wing-bone.

galewing_mail.name: Galewing Mail
galewing_mail.desc: Mail of overlapping scales that ripple like feathers.

imp_horn.name: Imp Horn
imp_horn.desc: A hooked black horn, warm at the root.

ember_fang.name: Ember Fang
ember_fang.desc: A hound's fang that glows when you breathe on it.

brimstone.name: Brimstone
brimstone.desc: A yellow lump that smells of struck matches.

vent_salt.name: Vent Salt
vent_salt.desc: White crust scraped from a vent. Rare, and bitter on the tongue.

ember_bloom.name: Ember Bloom
ember_bloom.desc: A red flower that grows only where the ground breathes fire.

hellfire_root.name: Hellfire Root
hellfire_root.desc: A black root that is still faintly hot, pulled from the hollow of an old vent.

cinder_pass.name: Cinder Pass
cinder_pass.desc: A scorched iron token. Veyra Dask says it opens the way onward, past the vent fields.

cinder_tonic.name: Cinder Tonic
cinder_tonic.desc: A warm amber tonic. Restores 160 HP.

brimstone_ether.name: Brimstone Ether
brimstone_ether.desc: A sharp yellow draught. Restores 70 MP.

hound_draught.name: Hound Draught
hound_draught.desc: A rich red brew. Restores 260 HP.

vent_remedy.name: Vent Remedy
vent_remedy.desc: Cures poison, curse, slow and weakened defence, and restores 120 HP.

sunfire_elixir.name: Sunfire Elixir
sunfire_elixir.desc: Gold and glowing. Restores 700 HP and 160 MP.

phoenix_draught.name: Phoenix Draught
phoenix_draught.desc: Revives a fallen ally with 60% HP.

grand_brew.name: Grand Brew
grand_brew.desc: The alchemist's masterpiece. Restores 1000 HP and 260 MP and cures every ailment.

dragonbone_sword.name: Dragonbone Sword
dragonbone_sword.desc: A blade of white dragon-bone, light and almost impossible to chip.

dragonbone_axe.name: Dragonbone Axe
dragonbone_axe.desc: A bearded axe of bone that has never been sharpened.

dragonbone_staff.name: Dragonbone Staff
dragonbone_staff.desc: A staff of fused vertebrae that hums against the magic you push through it.

dragonbone_bow.name: Dragonbone Bow
dragonbone_bow.desc: A bow of rib and sinew with a great draw.

dragonbone_dagger.name: Dragonbone Dagger
dragonbone_dagger.desc: A fang the length of a hand, set in a hilt.

dragonbone_mace.name: Dragonbone Mace
dragonbone_mace.desc: A mace headed with a knuckle of old bone.

dragonbone_plate.name: Dragonbone Plate
dragonbone_plate.desc: Overlapping plates of bone, warm in cold air and cold in warm.

dragonbone_hide.name: Dragonbone Hide
dragonbone_hide.desc: Hide studded with scales of bone.

dragonbone_cloak.name: Dragonbone Cloak
dragonbone_cloak.desc: A cloak lined with thin bone-scale that rattles very softly.

dragonbone_robe.name: Dragonbone Robe
dragonbone_robe.desc: A robe stitched with dragon-bone thread.

hexfang_blade.name: Hexfang Blade
hexfang_blade.desc: A blade with a curved fang for a guard. It pulls at the life of what it cuts.

siphon_staff.name: Siphon Staff
siphon_staff.desc: A staff that drinks a little of every spell cast through it and gives it back.

hexward_mace.name: Hexward Mace
hexward_mace.desc: A mace warded against curses. A kind of reverse witchcraft.

hexbat_hide.name: Hexbat Hide
hexbat_hide.desc: Armour of dark leather and bone. It folds around you like wings.

choir_key.name: Choir Key
choir_key.desc: A long key of drowned silver, cold to hold. It was taken from the Countess's belt. Perpetua Quell says it opens the gate to the Drowned Choir.

vampire_fang.name: Vampire Fang
vampire_fang.desc: A slender white fang with a groove down its length.

crimson_fang_blade.name: Crimson Fang Blade
crimson_fang_blade.desc: A blade with a ruby in the crossguard that drinks a little of whatever it cuts.

bloodtide_staff.name: Bloodtide Staff
bloodtide_staff.desc: A staff whose crystal moves slowly, like blood in a vein.

scarlet_bow.name: Scarlet Bow
scarlet_bow.desc: A bow of red lacquered horn. Its string hums a few notes of a waltz.

crimson_mace.name: Crimson Mace
crimson_mace.desc: A mace of dark iron with a bead of red glass set in the head.

bloodsilk_mail.name: Bloodsilk Mail
bloodsilk_mail.desc: Mail threaded with red silk. It feels warm against the skin, and rather watchful.

hearth_scroll.name: Sunsong Score
hearth_scroll.desc: A water-stained sheet of music in the temple script: the Sunsong, set for a single voice. The Warden says it can only be sung at the top of the Sun-Throne, by someone who is not afraid of the cost.

moonscale_pike.name: Moonscale Pike
moonscale_pike.desc: A long silver fish with scales like pale coins. It is still faintly warm. This is the one Corra Netwick has been chasing for thirty years.

grey_perch.name: Grey Perch
grey_perch.desc: A plain river perch. Restores 90 HP.

lamp_eel.name: Lamp Eel
lamp_eel.desc: An eel that glows faintly along its flank. Restores 180 HP.

bell_trout.name: Bell Trout
bell_trout.desc: A silver trout that rings softly when it is shaken. Restores 220 HP and 40 MP.

glass_carp.name: Glass Carp
glass_carp.desc: A see-through carp, rare and delicate. Restores 400 HP and 100 MP.

gargoyle_chip.name: Gargoyle Chip
gargoyle_chip.desc: A flake of grey stone with a tiny fossil of a feather in it.

gravelhewn_blade.name: Gravelhewn Blade
gravelhewn_blade.desc: A blade hewn from a single slab of choir stone. It hums when struck.

resonant_staff.name: Resonant Staff
resonant_staff.desc: A staff of fluted stone that answers every spell with a low sung note.

stonehawk_bow.name: Stonehawk Bow
stonehawk_bow.desc: A bow of carved basalt wing-bone. Its arrows fly unnaturally straight.

choirstone_mace.name: Choirstone Mace
choirstone_mace.desc: A mace of a single resonant stone. Every blow chimes.

gargoylehide_mail.name: Gargoylehide Mail
gargoylehide_mail.desc: Mail of grey stone scales that flex like cloth until the moment of a blow.

hearth_key.name: Hearth Key
hearth_key.desc: A fist-sized iron key, warm to hold, with a flame cut into the bow. The Warden guarded it for nine centuries. It opens the way to the Dragon's Hearth.

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.desc: A palm-wide scale, hot as a loaf and red as a coal at its edge.

shade_cloth.name: Shade Cloth
shade_cloth.desc: A scrap of something that is only a shadow when you do not look at it. It holds a faint echo of a voice.

caldrith_ember.name: Caldrith's Ember
caldrith_ember.desc: A coal of the first fire, given freely by the Elder Dragon. It does not burn the hand that holds it.

sun_key.name: Sun Key
sun_key.desc: A key of beaten gold, cut like a ray of light. It opens the road to the Sun-Throne.

wyrmfang_blade.name: Wyrmfang Blade
wyrmfang_blade.desc: A sword ground from a single wyrm fang. The edge glows faintly when danger is near.

emberglass_staff.name: Emberglass Staff
emberglass_staff.desc: A staff of glass drawn from the Hearth itself. It is always warm and never melts.

drakewing_bow.name: Drakewing Bow
drakewing_bow.desc: A bow strung with a wing tendon. Its arrows crackle faintly in flight.

scalebound_mace.name: Scalebound Mace
scalebound_mace.desc: A mace bound in overlapping scales. Every blow carries a little of the dragon.

wyrmscale_mail.name: Wyrmscale Mail
wyrmscale_mail.desc: Mail of dragon scale, overlapped like roof tiles. It sheds flame and flatters nobody.

sunstone.name: Sunstone
sunstone.desc: A coal of true sunlight, small enough to hold in a palm that no longer glows. It is warm all the way through.

silverglass_blade.name: Silverglass Blade
silverglass_blade.desc: A blade of silvered glass that shows the wielder their own face, a little braver than they feel.

lookingglass_staff.name: Lookingglass Staff
lookingglass_staff.desc: A staff with a polished mirror for a head. Spells leave it brighter than they entered.

veilglass_bow.name: Veilglass Bow
veilglass_bow.desc: A bow of drawn glass. Its arrows are almost invisible until they land.

mirrorbound_mace.name: Mirrorbound Mace
mirrorbound_mace.desc: A mace bound in shards of mirror. Curses glance off it.

shadeweave_mail.name: Shadeweave Mail
shadeweave_mail.desc: Mail woven from shade cloth, light as breath and hard as a grudge.
